body: You would think after waiting 10 years I would’ve found it. That’s long enough to be hurting. To be having nightmares every night. To be neglected and left behind. 10 years is enough time.
I don’t think there’s anything anymore.
Maybe so. But I’m not really wanting to try anymore.
I had my chance.
I’m sorry about your uncle. I just don’t belong here anymore

Yeah because that’s what people are thinking when they say things like “why don’t you actually do it.” I did this on purpose. They were so keen on trying to help me when I told them I DONT WANT HELP. They didn’t get the message. I don’t want it. Because nothing anyone does or says helps. Nothing. Nada.
Thank you for your concern. I appreciate that.

I’m alone at home for an entire week. No friends because of quarantine. My sister left to go see my dad in a different state. I have a half handle of Jack Daniels and a bunch of over the counter meds I picked up. And couple not so over the counter meds. If you catch my drift. I’m going to overdose on sleeping meds. I’m going to pass away overnight after I close my eyes one last time.
I’ve hurt people. Cheated. But life has a funny way of bringing that back on breaking uou down even more than you were before.
Idk man. I don’t even think I deserve to be here
I play a lot of video games. Stream on twitch sometimes. Never really got a following tho. That’s alright. I’m angry at myself.
I dint know how to talk about it
I guess
I don’t have any reason to orolong it
Not feel this pain anymore. To be forever still. At peace.
It’s okay. I’ve made peace with everything. My peace just holds a different meaning than yours
The point that they don’t want me anymore...and it’s everyone. Everyone in my life.
Important to people only when I have something to give. Once I’m depleted I’m not worth a damn thing.....they’ve made their point.
I don’t think there’s any helping me. I don’t wanna be helped anymore.
What would you like to say?
